描述_EN: the peach in he xiangu's basket is a daoist fruit symbolising immortality. over the centuries, all kinds of fantastic tales increasingly embellished the stories of their lives. items such as this bronze object may have come from temples rather than tombs. originally historical persons, the 'immortals' became so in the imagination of successive generations because they were thought of as supernatural beings with extraordinary powers. this candlestick is borne by the bronze figure of he xiangu, one of the eight immortals venerated by the followers of the chinese daoist faith.
描述_ZN: 何仙姑篮中的桃子是道教的水果，象征着不朽。 几个世纪以来，各种奇妙的故事越来越多地美化了他们的生活故事。 像这样的青铜器可能来自于寺庙而不是墓穴。 原为历史人物，"神仙 "在历代人的想象中变得如此，因为他们被认为是具有超自然力量的人。 这个烛台由何仙姑的铜像承受，何仙姑是中国道教信仰者所敬仰的八仙之一。
